peek_line.name: rootsFrom with no files: two spaces after the key
peek_line.out:
peek() {
  files=$1; dirs=$2; shift 2
  for r; do
    printf '\036r%s\037' "$r"
    printf '%s\n' "$files" | while IFS= read -r f; do [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$r/$f" ] && { printf '\036f%s/%s\037' "$r" "$f"; head -c 262144 "$r/$f"; }; done
    printf '%s\n' "$dirs" | while IFS=' ' read -r k d; do
      [ -n "$d" ] || continue
      if [ "$d" = . ]; then p=$r; else p=$r/$d; fi
      [ -d "$p" ] || continue
      printf '\036d%s\037' "$p"
      find -L "$p" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth "$k" 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r x; do printf '%s\037' "${x#"$p"/}"; done
    done
  done
}
from() {
  k=$1; shift
  for f; do [ -f "$f" ] && LC_ALL=C grep -o "\"$k\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"[^\"\\]*\"" "$f"; done | sed 's/^"[^"]*"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"//; s/"$//' | sort -u
}

WSP_APP_SERVER_PID=$!

answers=0
printf '%s\n' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"clientInfo":{"name":"wsp","version":"0"}}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"plugin/list","params":{}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"config/read","params":{"includeLayers":true}}' >&3
while [ "$answers" -lt 3 ] && IFS= read -r -t 10 -u 4 line; do
  printf '%s\n' "$line"
  case $line in '{"id":'*) answers=$((answers + 1)) ;; esac
done
exec 3>&- 4<&-
kill "$WSP_APP_SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || :
rm -rf "$WSP_PROBE_DIR" (30000 ms)
